title: personal-llm-inference-mini-sheet-q1-2026
content:
Mini experiment tracker - Q1 2026
Purpose: quick personal sheet to track small inference tuning experiments (batching, kv-cache, quant) before formalizing in a PR/bench repo. Mostly rough notes + perf numbers.

Columns:
Date, Experiment, Model, Hardware, Batch size, KV cache, Quantization, Prompt/Load, Avg latency (ms), 95th latency (ms), Tokens per req, Throughput (req/s), Quality metric (EM/ROUGE/QA-F1), Notes, Next steps

Rows:
2026-01-08, tiny-batch-optim, vicuna-13b, g4dn.12xlarge, 1 -> 4 (iter), off, q4_0, short chat (user->assistant few-shot), 210 -> 95, 420 -> 180, 350, 6.5 -> 15.2, QA-F1 0.72, baseline on single request, CPU overhead from batching small, try continuous batching/window=50ms
2026-01-15, kv-cache-prefetch, llama2-13b, p4d, 1, on (prefetch on hot prefixes), q4_0, doc summarization long context, 320, 520, 1200, 3.8, ROUGE-L 0.48, big drop in 95th with prefetch, memory spike observed, add eviction heuristics
2026-01-21, quant-profile, mixtral-8x7b, a100, 2, off, q8_0, short chat, 140, 210, 280, 11.2, QA-F1 0.69, quant reduced mem, small perf win, check fp16 baseline for quality regression
2026-01-28, batch-groups, vicuna-13b, p4d, 8 (agg->16), on, q4_0, summary workload, 480, 750, 1800, 24.3, ROUGE-L 0.46, throughput good but tail latency spikes, need per-tenant priority scheduling
2026-02-03, prompt-split, llama2-13b, g4dn.12xlarge, 1, on, q4_0, split long prompt into chunks, 280, 330, 1600, 5.0, QA-F1 0.71, slight quality drop - re-evaluate chunk merging strategy

Notes to self:
- Numbers are rough-ish, measured with a local harness (see linked PR) and small synthetic load. Treat as pre-validated.
- For any experiment intended for Dedicated or Private, create formal bench and link JIRA ticket + PR.
- TODO: repro script for kv-cache-prefetch memory regression (JIRA-MLINF-218).
- Questions: is q4_0 still recommended for 13B series? check L2 perf on p4d vs a100.
- Keep track of cost delta estimates (tokens/sec cost) next pass.

Quick action items:
- (Ethan) can you run kv-cache eviction trace on p4d with 200 concurrent long-context reqs? (tagging in Slack)
- (Avery) prototype 50ms batching window as a local config flag, measure tail latency

Relevant links (notes & temp refs):
- Local harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench/tree/personal/maya-mini-harness
- Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/342
- JIRA: JIRA-MLINF-218 (kv cache memory regression)
- Slack thread: eng-runtime "kv-prefetch test" (thread id 12345)

Free-form scratch area:
- idea: adaptive batch threshold based on recent inter-arrival distribution - if p50 inter-arrival < 20ms, use larger batching window for non-priority routes. Might reduce throughput variance.
- note: sometimes CLI measured latency differs from dashboard by ~5-8% because dashboard uses end-to-end including auth + routing.
- half-baked: add micro-bench marker in runtime for "kv_lookup_time" to correlate with stall events.

End of sheet (rough).
